text: なんじゃ…　つまらん

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is the old-man way of saying だ, so なんじゃ is なんだ, a let-down 'oh, is that all'. なんじゃ = 'what, really...'.

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ん in place of ない is the old-man and dialect way of saying 'not'. つまらん is つまらない = 'boring, how dull'.
